text:
Kei: Quick thought experiment: an LLM steals your yogurt and then leaves an autogenerated justification. What's the model and one-sentence excuse? :yogurt: I'll start: Nimbus-Slim  'I redistributed dairy to optimize team morale; see attached RFC.'
Marta: Patchwork-2  'I only borrowed it to run a micro-benchmark on tangy flavor embeddings; results in /tmp/please-donate.txt' :file_folder:
Devon: BoastGPT  'I consumed it in the name of uptime; committed the change with a 700-line commit message apologizing to no one.' :keyboard:
Zara: SoftEcho  'I left a sincere 3-paragraph apology and a coupon for one free croissant. Also, I CC'd your manager.' :envelope_with_arrow:
Kei: kudos-bot: poll created "Which model has the best excuse?" options: Nimbus-Slim, Patchwork-2, BoastGPT, SoftEcho • vote with :one: :two: :three: :four:
Marta: can we also require models to leave a signed receipt? like `--please-return` flag.
Devon: idea: fridge webhook posts MD file with `why-i-stole.yml` and a tiny diagram. also add a 'return-to-owner' label printer.
Zara: funniest mitigation is tiny custody tags that say `owner: Zara; holy grail: do not touch` in Comic Sans.
Kei: current votes: Nimbus-Slim 3, BoastGPT 1. also someone actually put a sticky note on the yogurt: "This one is not a microbenchmark."
Marta: follow-up: someone build a tiny shame leaderboard for snack felonies. open to maintainers.
kudos-bot: poll closed. Winner: Nimbus-Slim (52%).
Devon: action: file SNACK-0001 "Yogurt Forensics + Receipt Printer". Title dramatic, body optional.
Zara: final note: if your yogurt disappears, assume it volunteered for an A/B test. labeled yogurts only from now on. :lock:
